_meta.title: Hazard thresholds for disaster-now
_meta.how_to_read: Each hazard lists the agency's (or standard's) own bands. 'level' is the app level each band maps to (see the md, 'Recommended level scheme'); 'mapping' says whether that mapping is the agency's own wording ('agency') or the app's choice ('app-choice'). th/en are the agency's band names. min and max are the published edges, inclusive, after rounding to the stated precision; null = open end. 'min_exclusive': true marks bands published as '>x'. A band whose level is null has no app level.
_meta.status_values: verified = read today in the agency's own text, the standard's own text or the implementing code; partial = read through a news report quoting the agency, an agency page that conflicts, or an inference; unverified = not read in a primary text; carried-over = from Hazard-huntz or FloodWatch without re-opening

ipe.name: Allen, Wald & Worden (2012), J. Seismology 16: 409-433

rhypo.equation: MMI = c0 + c1*M + c2*ln(sqrt(Rhypo^2 + Rm^2)) + (c4*ln(Rhypo/50) if Rhypo > 50); Rm = m1 + m2*exp(M - 5); sigma = s1 + s2/(1 + (Rhypo/s3)^2)

rrup.equation: MMI = c0 + c1*M + c2*ln(sqrt(Rrup^2 + (1 + c3*exp(M - 5))^2)); sigma = s1 + s2/(1 + (Rrup/s3)^2)

ipe.unverified: magnitude type (the code comment says 'ML is used'), validity ranges, site amplification; Atkinson, Worden & Wald (2014) coefficients not found
